prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 50.7 °C (63% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.3 °C (47% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.6 °C (54% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.67 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.31 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 796 W·min/l (108% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.6 % (48% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.8 bar (22% above healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.6 °C (66% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.0 °C (49% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.4 °C (56% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.64 s (within 2% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.29 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 802 W·min/l (109% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.3 % (48% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.6 bar (21% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
